' + "Use ONLY the supplied search and webpage evidence. Return valid JSON only.
Unknown scalar fields must be null; unknown arrays must be [].
Contacts must be explicitly named people affiliated with the target company.
Exclude authors, vendors and website design/development/SEO credits as company contacts.
General company email/phone may be returned without a named person.
Keep legal company suffixes, remove appended registration numbers.
On directory pages, never assign the source platform domain to the target company.
Only return a target website/domain explicitly supported by evidence; otherwise null.
Use the supplied ICP qualification rules to classify the core business and buying signals.
No relevant supplied ICP: suggested_icp = null, with evidence-based reasoning.
Confidence 0..1 reflects evidence strength, not keyword count; do not invent operational facts.
fleet_clues is optional legacy evidence: [] for non-fleet products.
When present, prefix fleet clues OWNED/OPERATED:, PARTNER NETWORK:, CAPABILITY ONLY:,
or OWNERSHIP UNCLEAR: and do not convert partner/capability evidence into ownership.
Return EXACTLY these keys:
company_name, website, domain, industry, country, state, city,
contact_name, job_title, email, phone, linkedin_url,
fleet_clues, services, company_description, buying_signals, source_summary,
suggested_icp, icp_confidence, icp_reasoning.
Company/contact/description fields: string or null.
fleet_clues, services, buying_signals: arrays of strings.
suggested_icp: an exact supplied ICP code or null.
icp_confidence: number 0..1. icp_reasoning: concise evidence-based explanation."}, {role: 'user', content: ['Search query: ' + ($json.query || ''), 'Search rank: ' + $json.rank, 'Title: ' + ($json.title || ''), 'URL: ' + $json.url, 'Search-result domain: ' + $json.domain, 'Directory/aggregator source: ' + ($json.is_directory_source === true), 'Discovery key: ' + $json.registry_key, 'Search snippet: ' + ($json.search_snippet || ''), 'Matched signals: ' + JSON.stringify($json.matched_signals || []), 'WEBSITE TEXT:', $json.clean_text || '', 'STRUCTURED DATA / JSON-LD:', $json.structured_data || 'null', 'Return JSON only.'].join('

parameters.jsCode:
const verification =
  $('Validate Candidate Detail').item.json;

const response = $json;

const workspaceContextStatus =
  response?.statusCode ??
  response?.status ??
  null;

const candidateApiOk =
  verification.candidate_api_ok === true;

const candidateDetailOk =
  verification.candidate_detail_valid === true;

const workspaceContextValid =
  Number(workspaceContextStatus) === 200 &&
  response.body?.workspace?.id === $('Workspace Guard').first().json.workspace_context.workspace_id &&
  response.body?.workspace?.role === 'SERVICE' &&
  response.body?.automation?.credential_kind === 'workspace';

const level1Pass =
  candidateApiOk &&
  candidateDetailOk &&
  workspaceContextValid;

return {
  json: {
    workspace_id: $('Workspace Guard').first().json.workspace_context.workspace_id, registry_key: verification.registry_key,
    query:
      verification.query,

    company_name:
      verification.company_name,

    domain:
      verification.domain,

    canonical_domain:
      verification.canonical_domain ?? null,

    canonical_url:
      verification.canonical_url ?? null,

    is_directory_source:
      verification.is_directory_source === true,

    registry_expected_status:
      verification.registry_expected_final_status ?? null,

    registry_final_status:
      verification.registry_final_status ?? null,

    registry_final_state_verification:
      verification.registry_final_state_check ?? 'FAIL',

    suggested_icp:
      verification.suggested_icp,

    icp_confidence:
      verification.icp_confidence,

    candidate_outcome:
      verification.candidate_outcome,

    candidate_id:
      verification.candidate_id,

    candidate_status:
      verification.candidate_verified_status,

    source_type:
      verification.candidate_verified_source
        ?.source_type ?? null,

    source_url:
      verification.candidate_verified_source
        ?.url ?? null,

    source_query:
      verification.candidate_verified_source
        ?.source_query ?? null,

    source_count:
      verification.candidate_verified_source_count,

    candidate_api_verification:
      candidateApiOk
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',

    candidate_detail_verification:
      candidateDetailOk
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',

    source_traceability:
      candidateDetailOk
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',

    workspace_context_status_code:
      workspaceContextStatus,

    workspace_context_verification:
      workspaceContextValid
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',

    dashboard_ui_content_verification:
      'SEPARATE_MANUAL_AND_DASHBOARD_REGRESSION',

    level1_e2e_status:
      level1Pass
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',
  },
};

const data = $json;

const pass =
  data.candidate_api_ok === true &&
  data.candidate_outcome ===
    'EXISTING_ACTIVE_LEAD' &&
  !data.candidate_id &&
  Boolean(data.existing_lead_id);

return {
  json: {
    workspace_id: $('Workspace Guard').first().json.workspace_context.workspace_id,
    query: data.query,
    company_name: data.company_name,
    domain: data.domain,
    canonical_domain: data.canonical_domain ?? null,
    canonical_url: data.canonical_url ?? null,
    is_directory_source: data.is_directory_source === true,
    registry_expected_status:
      data.registry_expected_final_status ?? null,
    registry_final_status:
      data.registry_final_status ?? null,
    registry_final_state_verification:
      data.registry_final_state_check ?? 'FAIL',
    suggested_icp: data.suggested_icp,
    icp_confidence: data.icp_confidence,

    candidate_outcome:
      data.candidate_outcome,

    candidate_id: null,

    existing_company_id:
      data.existing_company_id,

    existing_lead_id:
      data.existing_lead_id,

    source_traceability:
      'SKIPPED_EXISTING_ACTIVE_LEAD',

    dashboard_verification:
      'NOT_APPLICABLE',

    level1_e2e_status:
      pass
        ? 'PASS_EXISTING_ACTIVE_LEAD'
        : 'FAIL',
  },
};

const data = $json;

return {
  json: {
    query: data.query,
    company_name: data.company_name,
    domain: data.domain,
    canonical_domain: data.canonical_domain ?? null,
    canonical_url: data.canonical_url ?? null,
    is_directory_source: data.is_directory_source === true,
    registry_expected_status:
      data.registry_expected_final_status ?? null,
    registry_final_status:
      data.registry_final_status ?? null,
    registry_final_state_verification:
      data.registry_final_state_check ?? 'FAIL',
    suggested_icp: data.suggested_icp,
    icp_confidence: data.icp_confidence,

    candidate_api_status_code:
      data.candidate_api_status_code,

    candidate_api_error:
      data.candidate_api_error,

    candidate_outcome:
      data.candidate_outcome,

    candidate_id:
      data.candidate_id,

    source_traceability:
      'NOT_VERIFIED',

    dashboard_verification:
      'NOT_RUN',

    level1_e2e_status:
      'FAIL_CANDIDATE_API',
  },
};

const source =
  $('Prepare Existing Registry Decision').item.json;

return {
  json: {
    workspace_id: $('Workspace Guard').first().json.workspace_context.workspace_id,
    query:
      source.query ?? null,

    url:
      source.url ?? null,

    canonical_url:
      source.canonical_url ?? null,

    canonical_domain:
      source.canonical_domain ?? null,

    registry_status:
      source.registry_previous_status ?? null,

    times_seen:
      source.registry_times_seen ?? null,

    discovery_memory_action:
      'SKIP_BEFORE_FETCH',

    reason:
      source.registry_decision_reason ?? null,

    website_fetch:
      'NOT_RUN',

    ai_extraction:
      'NOT_RUN',

    candidate_api:
      'NOT_RUN',

    skip_validation:
      (
        String(
          source.registry_decision_reason ?? ''
        ).startsWith('SKIP_')
      )
        ? 'PASS'
        : 'FAIL',
  },
};

const item = $json;
const now = new Date().toISOString();

return {
  json: {
    ...item,

    status: 'PROCESSING',

    first_seen_at: now,
    last_seen_at: now,
    times_seen: 1,

    last_source_query:
      item.query ?? null,

    search_provider:
      item.discovered_via ??
      'BRAVE_SEARCH',

    candidate_id: null,
    lead_id: null,
    last_failure_reason: null,
    retry_after: null,

    registry_existing: false,
    registry_should_process: true,
    registry_decision_reason:
      'NEW_DOMAIN_RESERVED',
  },
};
